## Complete Project Catalog

### 1. Resort POS: Offline-First Resort Management & Audit System
- **URL**: /projects/resort-pos-management-system
- **Description**: A full-stack, offline-capable Point of Sale (POS) and property management system for resorts featuring 30s Cloudflare Workers edge sync, SHA-256 HMAC cryptographic audit ledgers, ESP32 IoT gate counter integration, and browser-based AI desk monitoring.
- **Detailed Overview**: Resort POS & Management System is a full-stack, offline-first Point of Sale (POS) and property management system engineered specifically for cash-heavy resorts and hospitality venues. Built to operate seamlessly during local internet outages while mirroring data to a Cloudflare Workers + D1 serverless cloud every 30 seconds for remote owner visibility, its primary innovation is an anti-skimming architecture that cryptographically secures transactions and cross-references sales against physical gate entries and housekeeping statuses.
- **Technical Achievements**:
  1. Local-First Edge Synchronization: Resilient local network server (Node.js + SQLite) syncing incrementally to Cloudflare Workers + D1 every 30 seconds.
  2. Cryptographic Audit Trail & Signed Receipts: SHA-256 hash-chained audit log with HMAC-signed QR code receipts verified by gate guards and guests.
  3. IoT Gate Counter & Hardware Telemetry: Custom C++ firmware for ESP32 microcontroller tallying vehicle entries via inductive loops and arm switches.
  4. On-Device AI Desk Attendance Monitoring: Browser-based Google MediaPipe (EfficientDet-Lite) computer vision monitoring cashier attendance offline.
  5. Anti-Skimming Decentralized Workflow: Role isolation across Cashier, Gate Guard, and Housekeeping to catch cash skimming or unbilled occupancy.
  6. Philippine Statutory Compliance: BIR TRAIN Law tax rules, Senior Citizen/PWD statutory discount tracking (20% discount + ID logs), and Data Privacy Act (RA 10173) compliance.
- **Tech Stack**: Node.js, Express, SQLite, Cloudflare Workers, Cloudflare D1, ESP32 (C++), Google MediaPipe, HTML/JS/CSS.

### 2. n8n AI-Powered Email Processing Pipeline
- **URL**: /projects/n8n-gmail-email-pipeline
- **Description**: Automated inbound Gmail ingestion using OpenAI to classify email categories, managing Gmail labels, logging senders to Google Sheets, and archiving attachments to Google Drive in parallel.
- **Detailed Overview**: Production-grade automation workflow built in n8n demonstrating AI classification, idempotent resource management, conditional branching, and parallel Google Workspace integration.
- **Tech Stack**: n8n, OpenAI Chat Model, Gmail API, Google Drive API, Google Sheets API.

### 3. n8n Telegram Receipt Processing & Expense Logging Engine
- **URL**: /projects/n8n-telegram-receipt-engine
- **Description**: Intercepts mobile receipt photos via Telegram Webhook, uses Google Gemini multimodal vision (temp=0) to extract merchant, amount, and date into Google Sheets, and archives timestamped receipts in Google Drive.
- **Tech Stack**: n8n, Google Gemini Vision API, Telegram Bot API, Google Drive API, Google Sheets API.

### 4. Enterprise Online Secured Payroll Web Application
- **URL**: /projects/payroll-online-web
- **Description**: A full-stack, enterprise-grade payroll web app with Next.js 14, FastAPI (Python), TailwindCSS, and PostgreSQL/SQLite. Automates BIR Withholding Tax calculations, statutory contribution tables (SSS 2025, PhilHealth 5%, Pag-IBIG Circular 460), AES-256 field encryption, and 1-payslip-per-page print exports.
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js 14, FastAPI (Python), PostgreSQL, Pydantic v2, AES-256 Fernet Encryption, Tailwind CSS.

### 5. LearnMate (Mobile-Based Android App)
- **URL**: /projects/learnmate
- **Description**: An Android app to streamline remote learning with session booking, messaging, and video conferencing built with Flutter, Dart, and Agora RTC SDK.
- **Tech Stack**: Dart, Flutter, Agora RTC SDK, Firebase Firestore, Firebase Auth.

### 6. Wood Knot Detection App
- **URL**: /projects/wood-knot-detection
- **Description**: An on-device, real-time app identifying wood knots using a YOLOv8 model trained on 10,000+ images, optimized via ONNX, and run on TensorFlow Lite.
- **Tech Stack**: Flutter, Dart, YOLOv8, PyTorch, ONNX, TensorFlow Lite.

### 7. Capstone: Braille Haptic Reader
- **URL**: /projects/braille-haptic-reader
- **Description**: An OCR-to-Braille translation pipeline on Raspberry Pi using YOLOv5 for visually impaired users.
- **Tech Stack**: Raspberry Pi 4, Python, YOLOv5, OpenCV, Tesseract OCR, Solenoid Haptic Actuators.

### 8. Custom Payroll Management System
- **URL**: /projects/custom-payroll-system
- **Description**: A bespoke desktop payroll system using Python and PyQt for precise, efficient financial management.
- **Tech Stack**: Python, PyQt6, PostgreSQL.
